🏆 Celebrating outstanding research in the social sciences!

The Fritz Thyssen Foundation Prize for Social Science Articles 2025 has been awarded for the 45th time. Congratulations to this year’s prize winners! 🎉📚

🥇 Daniela Braun & Giuseppe Carteny
🥈 Jan-Otmar Hesse

The prestigious award recognises outstanding contributions published in German-language social science journals. 🔬✨
